[*][size=4]非常感谢[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/umganil]umganil[/url]允许我制作[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35559](CP)(MMAP)Wherewindsmeet Qinghe[/url]﻿的FF版本!!❥(^_-)[/size]

[*][size=4]建议配合[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23488]精密家具[/url]﻿、[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19675]快乐家居设计师[/url]、[url=https://github.com/Sparky56p/AnythingAnywhere/releases]AnythingAnywhere[/url]﻿使用❤[/size]



[/list][b][size=4]家具功能（中文）：[/size][/b]

[list]
[*][size=4]新增[u]Wherewindsmeet_Qinghe[/u]作为[ff]家具目录在罗宾商店里售出[/size]
[/list][list]
[*][size=4]﻿所有家具都设置了合理的、可通行的碰撞格[/size]
[*][size=4]家具名字前面有“[/size][u][size=5]*[/size][/u][size=4]“代表其有放置物品/储存物品功能[/size]
[/list][list=1]
[*][size=3]空桌子可以右键摆放物品（如何摆放、可以放多少请看上面的展示图） ﻿ps.把桌子上的东西全部拿走才可以移动桌子[/size]
[*][size=3]一些柜子增加了储物功能（具体家具介绍有说明）[/size]
[/list][list]
[*][size=4]所有的灯都可以手动开关（白天黑夜皆可以，且依旧有时间变化）[/size]
[/list][list]
[*][size=4]所有的椅子（包括坐垫）都有四个方向，右键旋转改变[/size]
[/list]

------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[size=4]Furniture Function (English):
[/size]
[list]
[*][size=4]Added Wherewindsmeet_Qinghe is sold as an [ff] furniture catalog in Robin's Store[/size]
[*][size=4]﻿All furniture have reasonable, walkable collision grids[/size]
[*][size=4]Furniture names prefixed with "[/size][b][u][size=5]*[/size][/u][/b][size=4]" indicate they have item placement/storage functionality[/size]
[/list][list=1]
[*][size=3]Empty tables can be right-clicked to place items (Refer to the image above for placement methods and capacity) ﻿[/size]ps.Remove everything from the table before moving the table
[*][size=3]Some cabinets have added storage function (See specific furniture descriptions for details)[/size]
[/list][list]
[*][size=4]All lights can be manually toggled on/off (Works day or night, while still reflecting time changes)[/size]
[*][size=4]All chairs (including bench) have four directions; right-click to rotate[/size]
[/list]
